_doc: Shared tuning for official business-site reads. scripts/refresh-official-commerce-links.ts deterministically preserves real menu, order, reservation, catering, and gift-card anchors without an AI key. scripts/ingest-business-info.ts separately uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for supported prose facts. Its bounded queue reads public places missing decision-useful Radius copy before routine food-and-drink refreshes; --plan shows the queue without fetching pages or using the model. Neither path constructs commerce URLs. Both validate fetches, prefer HTTPS, may fall back to a headless render for JS-only sites, and exclude social networks, directories, marketplaces, and government pages.
